2. Facts relevant for disposal of the suit, in brief, are that the petitioner got married to the respondent (defendant) on 27.09.2010 and the marriage was solemnized by the Clergy (Bishop), namely-Reverend Samuel Sunil Mankhin in the Saint John's Cathedral, Kushtia under the Diocese of Kushtia of the Church of Bangladesh (a Christian Church Denomination) in complying with the religious rituality as well as performing the social ceremonies in the presence of witnesses, and thus the marriage has duly been solemnized under the provisions of the Christian Marriage Act, 1872; that just after elapsing a couple of days after the solemnization of marriage, he (petitioner), came to know intimately that long before the marriage his wife's right 'ovary' (female egg-producing organ) had been excised/removed, which is termed in the medical science as 'right salpingo-Oophorectomy'. Soon after getting such news, he made a query and tried to justify the news from his wife (respondent), but neither his wife nor any of her family members disclosed or divulged the truth, rather they (respondent along with her family) always restored to establish the falsity; that the petitioner (plaintiff) waited for long 7 months vigorously intending to get the truth; nonetheless, has failed, which obviously, is an unprecedented event in the life of a married couple. and no sign of repentance has ever been seen in the manner and attitude of the respondent along with her family members who deliberately played a fraud in the marriage in concealing the real state of the physique of the respondent, which inevitably led him to swear an `affidavit of dissolution of marriage' before the learned Notary Public on 11.04.2011, V and that has been sent to the respondent as well as the Clergy (Bishop) who solemnized the marriage in the Church; that on 26.06.2011 the respondent, Ms. Sara Haider sent him (petitioner) a 'Legal Notice' challenging the sanctity of the 'affidavit of dissolution of marriage' sworn in by the petitioner on 11.04.2011 (Annexure-B) giving him 15 days’ time to withdraw the same; that thereafter the respondent instituted a suit being Suit No.68 of 2011 before the Court of Joint District Judge, Is' Court, Kushtia on 22.11.2011 impleading the petitioner as defendant praying for a decree to declare that the 'affidavit of dissolution of marriage' sworn in on 11.04.2011 by the petitioner on 27.04.2011 is unlawful, without legal basis and is not binding upon her (respondent), wherein the 4 did not appear before the Court to contest the suit; that it is evident from a `Discharge Certificate' issued by Dr. M.A. Latif, Surgeon from Quasem's Clinic (Pvt.) Ltd., Kushtia, dated 08.08.2004 that the respondent has been undergone medical surgery. namely `Appendisectomy + Rt. Oophorectomy' (that is 2 distinct operations at a time) on 31.07.2004, and on that ' occasion her (respondent) right ovary has been excised/removed: that after solemnization of marriage, the respondent was diagnosed in Sono Diagnostic Centre Ltd., Kushtia on 27.11.2010, and then it is found in the Ultra-Sonogram report as to her (respondent) `Adnexae' (Ovary/Ovaries) that—"one semi-circular cyst measuring about (3.2 X 3.0) cm. is present at left adnexal region. Right ovary is not visualized", vide the Ultra-Sonogram report given by Dr. Md. Rafiqul Islam Tota, MBBS, DMU on 27.11.2010. Hence the suit. 

 6. The learned advocate Mr. Titus Hind Rema appearing for the plaintiff (petitioner) and having placed the petition (plaint) along with the documents annexed and referring to the deposition of P.W.1 submits that the plaintiff has been able to prove his case as stated in the plaint that the marriage was solemnized by suppressing the fact that the `right ovary' (female egg-producing organ) of the defendant was had been excised/removed. Having learnt about this fact, he tried to get about the truth from the defendant and her family, but they did not disclose the fact. The petitioner has brought the defendant examined through Dr. M.A. Latif, a surgeon of Quasem's Clinic (Pvt.) Ltd., Kushtia and from a 'Discharge Certificate' dated 08.08.2004 he has come to learnt that the 'right ovary' of the defendant had been excised/removed. Besides, from an Ultra—Sonogram report, given by Dr. Md. Rafiqul Islam Tota, MBBS, DMU on 27.11.2010 also records that the 'right ovary' (of the defendant) is not visualized. In this circumstance the plaintiff has sworn an 'affidavit of dissolution of marriage' before the learned Notary Public on 11.04.2011. Accordingly, he submits that the plaintiff has made out a case to pass a decree for dissolution of marriage in this suit on the ground of committing fraud. 

 9. Hence, the fact of surgery in the year 2004 excising/removing the 'right ovary' of the respondent (defendant) as well as the fact of ultra-sonogram report dated 27.11.2010 are not proved. Besides, the plaintiff has also failed prove that the defendant has committed fraud on him before marriage, because, there is no allegation in petition (plaint) that before marriage the defendant Sara Haider had induced him (petitioner) or had otherwise obtained his consent to marry her by resorting to any fraudulent practice. It is the duty of the bridegroom to make all relevant queries about the bride and her family. Besides, a marriage is solemnized, in our society, once the bridegroom is satisfied and pleased with the family back ground, look and physical condition of the bride. Now, at this stage and after the marriage has been consummated, this type of allegation does not suit in the mouth of the bridegroom for his own selfish desire, by deserting a lady, by way of divorce putting all social disgrace and stigma on her, even if the allegation of subsequent discovery of excising `the right ovary' was found to be true. Besides, in the ulta-sonogram, it was reported that 'Tight ovary' is not visible. This is not similar to say that 'right ovary' does not exist. Any 'body may come across any accidental event that can cost him/her life or limbs, whether before or after marriage. This cannot be termed as fraud. This plaint/petition, in my View, has been filed for collateral purpose and is not malafide, and the allegations furnish any basis for the decree prayed for. 

 11. In my consider view, although the suit is heard ex-parte, nonetheless, the plaintiff/petitioner is not absolved from his onus to prove his case by adducing required decree of proof in order to succeed in his case, which the plaintiff has failed to do.
